menu_title.zh-CN: 可以从以下事情开始，也可以直接告诉我目标：
menu_title.en: You can start with any of these tasks, or describe your goal:

title.zh-CN: 上传自己的文件总结规则
title.en: Upload my data and learn rules

agent_steps: Use ADEPT isolated hydrogen-capped monomer HOMO–LUMO gap Top30% STCA as the featured calculation tutorial when a demonstration is requested. Read assets/examples/adept_gap_case.json. Keep the concise original STCA positioning; do not add a verbose Why STCA section or promote water contact angle as a high-performing example.

Run bundled morgan_evaluation.py via agent_runtime by default. Require a source-only fit manifest, exact split memberships, per-holdout nearest-source ECFP4 distances, frozen thresholds, fingerprint receipts and actual heldout predictions. Verify all artifacts using fingerprint_contract.py --run-dir RUN_DIR. Do not replace the pipeline with inline learners or raw-star MACCS.

When the user selects the supported OpenPoly water-contact-angle property, read assets/examples/water_contact_angle_case.json. Bind PSMILES and Water Contact Angle (deg), degrees, high direction. Zero degrees is valid complete wetting. Do not treat missing labels as zero or filter valid zero contact angles.

Read the uploaded polymer structures, target, units, direction and experimental/computed meaning; preserve original SMILES and select polymer_repeat_unit as the generation structure kind. Ask only for missing scientific information.

Before learning, bind the exact input file and row scope, structure column, numeric target column, unit and high/low direction, and briefly show that mapping to the user. Honor explicit user column names. Continue automatically for a unique unambiguous mapping or a matching known dataset template; when duplicate or competing columns, measured/computed labels, temperatures, statistics or units are ambiguous, show candidates and wait for the user before learning. Never infer the scientific target from value range alone. Pass exact header names through --smiles-column and required --target, then verify the actual run_manifest.learning_settings mapping; spreadsheet positions are explanatory only.

Preserve original star-containing polymer SMILES as the primary input/output structure. Build a separate H-cap calculation copy by hydrogen-capping supported terminal single-bond attachment points, compute MACCS rule fingerprints only from that copy, and return the stored original SMILES with the same stars and positions. Returning stars means retrieving the original structure, never reverse-capping or replacing hydrogen text. Already capped input is returned unchanged.

Accept the user’s explicitly requested percentages, including arbitrary valid tiers such as 7%, 15% or 25%. Once the scientific target is clear, omitted percentages automatically use Top or Bottom 10%, 20% and 30%; do not ask the user to choose percentages before starting.

Before any label-dependent preparation, split original structures into source, holdout and optional buffer using H-cap ECFP4 Morgan radius=2/2048 and enforce every holdout nearest-source Tanimoto distance >=0.5 by default. Preserve identical original/Hcap groups. Select no split using target values or final results; never substitute random CV, t-SNE peripheral roles or posthoc distance strata for a strict distance split. Report infeasible distance splitting explicitly.

By default use --wracc-max-literals auto --wracc-length-folds 3. Select the WRAcc length cap from 1,2,3,5,10,unlimited using grouped validation strictly inside each supplied training partition, with each inner cutoff fitted from inner training labels. Never use outer evaluation outcomes to select length. Repeat selection within full training data for the final model, save the chosen cap and actual length, and report insufficient selection evidence. Honor natural-language requests for a fixed positive maximum or unlimited; neither beam search nor STCA is exhaustive. Frozen catalog rules keep their exact saved conditions.

Use only source labels for all tier-specific cleaning, transformation, scan/support settings and fitted models. Select a method using a separate source-internal Morgan validation, then freeze and evaluate the final holdout without tuning on it. WRAcc is recommended only when its internal-validation average screening score exceeds STCA by more than0.02; evidence-insufficient selection is explicit. Retain and deliver both methods. Average screening score means(Matthews correlation coefficient+precision+F1)/3.

For every requested tier, show the source-derived physical cutoff/operator/unit, both methods original-table selected/unselected/unknown counts, independently heldout precision/recall/F1/Matthews correlation coefficient, and the recommendation based only on source-internal validation. Original-table rescreening counts are not independent holdout performance. Screen all rows, including buffer/unlabeled rows, with the same source-frozen model.

Return all original uploaded rows, original fields and molecular SMILES (including any original attachment points) for each requested method/tier, selected tables, full unmet rule conditions, unknown/no-rule states and input-preparation mapping. Deliver any independent candidate results separately.

Automatically save usable frozen models, exact constraints and complete bilingual prompts using the user rule library, export portable rule bundles, show friendly method-qualified names, report actual saved file paths and continue the conversation without forcing a menu. Retain reports when no usable rule exists; never save empty conditions as an all-pass rule.

Keep source-internal tuning, independent Morgan holdout evaluation and original-table rescreening separate. A grouped random CV inside source is a diagnostic only and cannot establish structural extrapolation. Do not globally preprocess target labels before the structural split, recalculate cutoffs from holdout labels, refit on all uploaded rows after evaluation, or use the final holdout to select method/tier/settings.

The task IDs and numbers are internal routing compatibility fields, not a native app interface. Offer a short conversational overview only when needed; accept direct natural-language goals without requiring numeric input. Show the real saved file names and paths after a successful save, and do not claim a My rules tab exists.

Expand score names in user-facing reports: the average screening score combines the Matthews correlation coefficient, precision and F1 score. Keep technical JSON field names internally; never expose CV AS as an unexplained user label.
ask_only_if_missing: unambiguous structure and numeric target column binding

percentage_policy.missing_physical_cutoff_behavior: report_not_provided; never invent a physical value or substitute a model-scale cutoff

title.zh-CN: 根据已有规则直接筛选

user_prompt.zh-CN: 用现成规则筛选这份候选表。
user_prompt.en: Screen this candidate table with existing rules.

agent_steps: Use ADEPT isolated hydrogen-capped monomer HOMO–LUMO gap Top30% STCA as the featured calculation tutorial when a demonstration is requested. Read assets/examples/adept_gap_case.json. Keep the concise original STCA positioning; do not add a verbose Why STCA section or promote water contact angle as a high-performing example.

Resolve named existing rules through the current task_menu rule directory. For the featured ADEPT isolated-monomer gap case, read assets/examples/adept_gap_case.json and honor the explicit Top30% STCA example. Its catalog recommendation remains WRAcc; never change either identity. Generation reuses the exact rule selected in the conversation. RadonPy is an additional dataset and water contact angle only a supported-property catalog entry, not a featured tutorial.

The current open-data directory provides STCA and WRAcc rules as primary and alternative methods for each source/property/tier. Let the user select a method or accept the marked primary after choosing the target. Do not combine the alternative methods unless explicitly requested; a single rule contains AND literals.

Honor user-defined percentages only when an exact frozen rule exists; never substitute a nearby tier or interpolate conditions/cutoffs. Once source, property and direction are clear, omitted percentages automatically apply the available exact Top/Bottom 10%, 20%, 30% defaults without another percentage question. Report any unavailable default tier. If the target is still unclear, offer target choices and wait; defaults do not choose a source or property.

By default, return separate STCA and WRAcc results for every requested available tier, together with their recorded AS evidence, primary method and recommendation reason. Apply methods separately, not as an AND or OR. Honor an explicit request for only STCA or only WRAcc. If the user accepts the recommendation for subsequent use, adopt the marked per-tier primary without another method-confirmation question. Show Top/Bottom, physical comparison, numeric cutoff and unit; mark missing evidence or an unavailable alternative honestly.

If the user or conversation already unambiguously specifies the rules and tier, reuse that explicit selection directly. Otherwise display the grouped rule catalog (saved rule files, STCA paper, GAS, RadonPy, ADEPT, OpenPoly → property → percentage) with concise evidence states, and ask only for the missing target choice before screening or generation. An already explicit natural-language rule selection needs no menu or repeated confirmation.

Keep the first rule directory compact: source, property, direction and available percentages. Show the selected rule physical cutoff, exact conditions and relevant evidence after selection; do not dump all model thresholds or benchmark tables at entry.

Identify and briefly state the uploaded candidate table and exact structure column from the file and conversation; ask if multiple structure columns are ambiguous. Applying a frozen structural rule does not require candidate density or other property labels. Preserve original star-containing SMILES, use a separate H-cap calculation copy, and return the stored original stars and attachment positions without reverse-capping.
Show readable dataset, property and percentage choices when a rule has not been selected; keep catalog IDs internal.

For a built-in rule, resolve its frozen catalog conditions and use the library screen; for a saved user rule, read user_rule_library.py show and apply its saved model and tier with stca_tools.py screen-candidates. Return original SMILES and every failed condition.

Complete the requested operation and any already authorized continuation; report the actual result and saved file paths, retain available files, and continue the conversation without claiming a native menu or saved-rule tab.

The task IDs and numbers are internal routing compatibility fields, not a native app interface. Offer a short conversational overview only when needed; accept direct natural-language goals without requiring numeric input. Show the real saved file names and paths after a successful save, and do not claim a My rules tab exists.

Expand score names in user-facing reports: the average screening score combines the Matthews correlation coefficient, precision and F1 score. Keep technical JSON field names internally; never expose CV AS as an unexplained user label.

percentage_policy.missing_physical_cutoff_behavior: report_not_provided; never invent a physical value or substitute a model-scale cutoff

title.zh-CN: 根据已有规则直接生成

user_prompt.zh-CN: 选择已有规则和生成方式，生成 20 个候选并核验。
user_prompt.en: Choose existing rules and a generation mode, then generate and verify 20 candidates.

agent_steps: Use ADEPT isolated hydrogen-capped monomer HOMO–LUMO gap Top30% STCA as the featured calculation tutorial when a demonstration is requested. Read assets/examples/adept_gap_case.json. Keep the concise original STCA positioning; do not add a verbose Why STCA section or promote water contact angle as a high-performing example.

Resolve named existing rules through the current task_menu rule directory. For the featured ADEPT isolated-monomer gap case, read assets/examples/adept_gap_case.json and honor the explicit Top30% STCA example. Its catalog recommendation remains WRAcc; never change either identity. Generation reuses the exact rule selected in the conversation. RadonPy is an additional dataset and water contact angle only a supported-property catalog entry, not a featured tutorial.

The current open-data directory provides STCA and WRAcc rules as primary and alternative methods for each source/property/tier. Let the user select a method or accept the marked primary after choosing the target. Do not combine the alternative methods unless explicitly requested; a single rule contains AND literals.

The selected exact frozen rule already defines its percentage. Do not implicitly expand generation to 10%, 20%, 30%. Honor user-defined percentages only when an exact frozen rule exists; if unavailable, offer a saved exact rule or learning from labelled data. If the user explicitly requests multiple tiers, prepare a separate session and prompt, generate and verify independently for every tier; never AND different tiers of the same property into a single prompt.

If the user requests automatic method choice or accepts the recommendation, apply the marked per-tier primary method without another method-confirmation question. Honor an explicitly named STCA or WRAcc method. Show each selected tier as Top/Bottom, physical comparison, numeric cutoff and unit.

If the user or conversation already unambiguously specifies the rules and tier, reuse that explicit selection directly. Otherwise display the grouped rule catalog (saved rule files, STCA paper, GAS, RadonPy, ADEPT, OpenPoly → property → percentage) with concise evidence states, and ask only for the missing target choice before screening or generation. An already explicit natural-language rule selection needs no menu or repeated confirmation.

Keep the first rule directory compact: source, property, direction and available percentages. Show the selected rule physical cutoff, exact conditions and relevant evidence after selection; do not dump all model thresholds or benchmark tables at entry.

Treat a general request to generate with existing rules as a request to show and choose existing rules first unless the selection is already explicit. Do not start proposing structures until the user has chosen a rule.

Offer two generation modes when none was specified: preview the complete prompt, allow adjustments and wait for explicit confirmation; or generate directly and verify. An unambiguous natural-language request such as ‘直接生成’ or ‘generate directly’ already selects direct mode. Do not ask again, but never infer direct mode from the number 3 or the menu title alone.

For saved user rules, read their exact constraints and complete prompts from user_rule_library.py show; for built-in rules, resolve the selected catalog item. Render the built-in generation template with the requested count and chemical preferences as necessary.

Use generation_session.py prepare with the selected exact constraints and mode to preserve the complete prompt. In preview mode, display the full prompt without omissions, permit user adjustments, and stop before proposing or sampling any structures. Only after observing the user explicitly confirm the current prompt may the agent call generation_session.py confirm with the actual user wording. Any prompt revision clears approval and requires fresh confirmation.

In direct mode, or after preview confirmation opens the session gate, invoke the current AI assistant on the prepared or approved complete prompt to actually generate the requested candidate structures. Then verify every original proposal with the same frozen rules and retain candidates, failures and counts. Writing a prompt file or reporting a dry run does not complete generation.

Complete the requested operation and any already authorized continuation; report the actual result and saved file paths, retain available files, and continue the conversation without claiming a native menu or saved-rule tab.

The task IDs and numbers are internal routing compatibility fields, not a native app interface. Offer a short conversational overview only when needed; accept direct natural-language goals without requiring numeric input. Show the real saved file names and paths after a successful save, and do not claim a My rules tab exists.

If RDKit or a numerical dependency fails to import, report verification unavailable due to the runtime error. Keep generated proposals as generated_unverified; do not count them as invalid SMILES, zero coverage or zero rule matches. Report verified pass/fail counts only after successful per-structure computation.

title.zh-CN: 先看完整 prompt，确认后生成
title.en: Review the full prompt before generating

description.zh-CN: 先展示完整 prompt，可调整；明确确认后，由当前 AI 助手生成并精确核验。
description.en: Read and adjust the complete prompt, then explicitly confirm before the current AI assistant generates and verifies candidates.

description.zh-CN: 按选定规则，由当前 AI 助手实际生成候选并逐条精确核验。
description.en: Have the current AI assistant generate candidates from the selected rules and verify every proposal.

percentage_policy.missing_physical_cutoff_behavior: report_not_provided; never invent a physical value or substitute a model-scale cutoff

zh-CN: 用刚才保存的规则筛选这份候选表。
用刚才保存的规则直接生成 20 个候选并核验。
en: Screen this candidate table with the rules just saved.
Generate and verify 20 candidates directly with the rules just saved.

score_explanation.zh-CN: 平均筛选评分是马修斯相关系数、精确率与F1分数的算术平均。明确标注其来自训练侧Morgan验证还是独立外推集；推荐只使用训练侧验证，不用最终外推分数选方法。
score_explanation.en: Average screening score is the arithmetic mean of Matthews correlation coefficient, precision and F1. Name whether it comes from source-internal Morgan validation or the independent holdout. Recommendations never use the final holdout.
